topic.title: Project or Property Name
topic.description: The real estate project or property to review. Can be a project name, location, or a general description.

language.title: Language
language.description: Output language. Use 'en' for English or 'th' for Thai.

product_category.title: Property Type
product_category.description: The real estate category to tailor the analysis framework.

review_angle.title: Review Angle
review_angle.description: The analysis perspective for the review.

include_pricing.title: Include Pricing Info
include_pricing.description: Whether to include approximate pricing and value analysis.

word_count.title: Maximum words (optional)
word_count.description: If provided, the review must not exceed this word count. Overrides length preset.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Preferred output format. Markdown uses headings and formatting. Plain text is optimized for text-to-speech.

property_details.title: Property Details (optional)
property_details.description: Describe the property's details: bedrooms, area, project name, year built, location, title deed type. The review will be based on these facts.

reference_images.title: Property Images
reference_images.description: Optional property images. When provided, the review will be based on visual analysis of the actual property shown.
